subject.title: fix(telegram): resolve DM topic thread ids

question: Should the Telegram plugin support Telegram channel direct-messages topics now as a separate transport contract, or keep this PR limited to the established private BotFather threaded-DM behavior?
rationale: The correct repair is not a local fallback: supporting channel direct messages requires distinct inbound identity, session handling, and outbound `direct_messages_topic_id` delivery semantics.

options.title: Add separate channel-DM topic support
options.body: Model the direct-messages topic identifier independently and prove inbound isolation plus outbound `direct_messages_topic_id` delivery after rebasing.

options.title: Narrow to private BotFather topics
options.body: Remove the `direct_messages_topic` fallback and retain only the existing private-DM `message_thread_id` contract if channel direct-message support is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Add separate channel-DM topic support
recommendation.body: Model the direct-messages topic identifier independently and prove inbound isolation plus outbound `direct_messages_topic_id` delivery after rebasing.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Telegram private-DM topic-routing work is the closest current-history boundary for deciding whether the new channel-DM contract belongs beside it.
